Continuity Markup on the Mac vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume cross-device Markup capability covers storefront language. macOS, iOS, and App Store Connect actually separate Markup handoff behavior from product-page copy:

  • Continuity Markup on the Mac — from Mac Preview, Finder, Mail, or Quick Look you choose Markup; macOS sends the PDF or image to a nearby iPhone or iPad on the same Apple ID. The buyer annotates in a Markup sheet; the marked-up file returns to the Mac. System Continuity behavior — outside AppLocale scope.
  • Handoff & Continuity prerequisites — Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, and same Apple ID must be active on both devices. Apple documents the setup — AppLocale does not configure buyer devices.
  • Continuity Markup marketing on the product page — description paragraphs, subtitle positioning, keywords, promotional text, and screenshot overlays that tell buyers your app aligns with Mac → iPhone/iPad Markup workflows, educates about annotate-on-iPad-then-return-to-Mac, or documents honest cross-device annotation scope. Connect text fields — this page.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China storefront. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, and screenshot caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of Continuity Markup positioning in the app.

An app that documents Continuity Markup workflows and a localized China listing are both valuable — neither replaces the other. AppLocale covers how you describe Mac-initiated Markup handoff on the store page, not whether your code implements PDF annotation for buyers.

Continuity Markup vs Sidecar Apple Pencil markup — hard disambiguation

Mac and iPad apps blur Sidecar extended-display markup with Continuity Markup sheet handoff. AppLocale covers Continuity Markup cross-device annotation marketing — not Sidecar second-display copy:

  • Continuity Markup (this page) — Mac Preview, Finder, Mail, or Quick Look → Markup → document opens on iPhone or iPad in a Markup sheet; annotated file returns to Mac. Gallery frames may show Mac Quick Look Markup buttons, iPhone/iPad Markup sheets, or Insert from iPhone/iPad Markup badges. zh-Hans terms: 连续互通标记, 标记, 在 iPhone 上标记, 用 iPad 标记 Mac 文件, 插入草图/标记.
  • Sidecar Apple Pencil markup (different) — iPad extends the Mac desktop as a true second display; Apple Pencil markup happens on the Sidecar canvas while the Mac app runs on the extended display. Settings → Displays → Sidecar — 随航 vocabulary — not Mac Quick Look Markup handoff. See Sidecar listing guide when iPad-as-second-monitor is your lead feature.

Your gallery may show Pencil annotation on one frame — but listing copy should name the correct surface per frame. A Sidecar extended-desktop mockup with Pencil strokes is not Continuity Markup Mac → iPhone sheet handoff unless that is what the screenshot shows. A Mac Quick Look Markup button sending a PDF to iPad is not Sidecar 随航 unless the frame depicts iPad-as-display setup.

Continuity Markup vs on-device Markup in Files, Photos, or Preview on iPhone alone

Indie teams conflate iPhone-only Markup with Mac-initiated Continuity Markup. AppLocale covers cross-device handoff listing metadata — link to contrast pages when buyers need disambiguation:

  • Continuity Markup (this page) — Mac initiates Markup; document travels to iPhone or iPad and returns annotated to the Mac. 用 iPad 标记 Mac 文件 and 连续互通标记 vocabulary when your English source markets Mac Preview, Finder, Mail, or Quick Look → Markup workflows.
  • On-device Markup in Files, Photos, or Preview on iPhone (different) — user opens a file already on iPhone or iPad and taps Markup in Files, Photos, or Preview on that device alone — no Mac handoff, no cross-device return path. 标记 vocabulary may overlap, but buyer intent is single-device annotation — not Mac → iPhone sheet transfer. See Files listing guide or Photos picker listing guide when on-device document workflows are your lead.

A screenshot of iPhone Markup inside Files is not Continuity Markup unless your English caption explicitly shows Mac-initiated handoff and return-to-Mac. Listing vocabulary must follow your gallery frames — do not keyword-stuff 连续互通标记 when English only shows iPhone-only Markup.

Continuity Markup vs Continuity Camera, Desk View, Center Stage, Scribble, and Notes drawing

Apple groups several Continuity-branded features indie teams conflate on one product page. AppLocale covers Continuity Markup listing metadata — not sibling features:

  • Continuity Camera (different) — iPhone as Mac webcam, Desk View overhead desk shots, Center Stage auto-framing on video calls — 连续性相机 vocabulary — not PDF Markup handoff. See Continuity Camera listing guide — Continuity Camera is video input on Mac, not Mac Quick Look → Markup sheet on iPad.
  • Center Stage (different lead story) — auto-framing on FaceTime and video calls under Settings → FaceTime or Camera — 人物居中 vocabulary — not document Markup. See Center Stage listing guide when auto-framing dominates your page — not Continuity Markup unless your gallery shows that frame.
  • Scribble (different) — handwriting-to-text in text fields with Apple Pencil on iPad — not PDF or image Markup sheet handoff from Mac.
  • Notes drawing & Freeform (different) — freeform sketches inside Notes or Freeform boards on iPad — not Mac-initiated Markup return-to-Mac workflows unless your English source genuinely markets both with equal weight.

Continuity-themed apps may mention several Apple features across one description — but each gallery frame and keyword should match the feature the screenshot actually shows. A Desk View desk shot is not a Mac Preview Markup handoff sheet, and a Notes doodle is not Insert from iPhone/iPad Markup unless that is what the frame depicts.

Continuity Markup vs Universal Control, Handoff, and AirDrop

Cross-device Mac workflows share Continuity marketing language. AppLocale covers Continuity Markup document-annotation listing copy — not cursor control, session resume, or share-sheet transfer:

  • Universal Control (different) — one keyboard and mouse controlling Mac and iPad as separate devices with separate displays — 通用控制 vocabulary — not Mac → iPad Markup sheet handoff. See Universal Control listing guide.
  • Handoff (different) — start on iPhone continue on Mac, pick up where you left off, Works with Handoff — 接力 vocabulary — not Mac Quick Look Markup sending a PDF to iPad. See Handoff listing guide.
  • AirDrop (different) — nearby file sharing via share sheet — 隔空投送 vocabulary — not the built-in Markup handoff sheet that returns annotated files to the originating Mac app. See AirDrop listing guide when share-sheet transfer is your lead feature.
  • Continuity Markup (this page) — Mac Preview, Finder, Mail, or Quick Look → Markup → annotate on iPhone or iPad → annotated file appears back on Mac. Document-annotation handoff — 连续互通标记 and 标记 vocabulary.

Your screenshots may show Handoff icons beside Mac productivity art. Listing copy should name each claim accurately per frame — a Handoff dock badge is not Continuity Markup unless the frame shows Mac-initiated Markup sheet handoff and return-to-Mac.

Third-party apps may complement this by educating buyers, aligning annotation UX with Continuity expectations, or documenting honest cross-device scope. Continuity Markup–specific vocabulary — what translates differently in zh-Hans

Cross-device annotation marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general localization guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers evaluate Continuity Markup — not a literal paste of US marketing:

连续互通标记 (Continuity Markup) vs 标记 (Markup)

Apple's Chinese system UI uses 连续互通 for the Continuity family and 标记 for the Markup tool. Product-page copy may use 连续互通标记 when emphasizing cross-device handoff from Mac to iPhone or iPad. A Settings walkthrough needs system-aligned phrasing; a benefit headline may use 在 iPhone 上标记 when accurate to your English source.

在 iPhone 上标记 vs 用 iPad 标记 Mac 文件

US pages use "Markup from Mac on iPhone or iPad", "Annotate on iPhone", or "Mark up on iPad and send back to Mac." China storefront copy uses 在 iPhone 上标记 or 用 iPad 标记 Mac 文件 on frames that walk buyers through Mac Preview → Markup → iPhone/iPad sheet workflows — not 随航 unless your English source genuinely markets Sidecar on that frame.

插入草图/标记 (Insert from iPhone/iPad Markup)

Mail and some Mac apps offer Insert from iPhone or iPad Markup — capture a sketch or markup on the mobile device and insert it into the Mac document. zh-Hans marketing uses 插入草图 or 插入标记 when your gallery shows that insertion workflow — not generic 分享 unless your English source markets share-sheet transfer instead.

Mac entry points: Preview, Finder, Mail, Quick Look

Continuity Markup starts from Mac Preview, Finder, Mail, or Quick Look → Markup — not Settings → Sidecar and not FaceTime Center Stage. Screenshot captions that walk buyers to the Markup button should use the Chinese app names buyers see on Mac — 预览, 访达, 邮件, 快速查看 — and name iPhone or iPad as the annotation surface.

Subtitle and keyword packing

The 30-character subtitle and 100-character keyword field need cross-device annotation search terms Chinese buyers type — see Simplified Chinese keywords & subtitle for field mechanics. Terms like 连续互通标记, 标记, and 用 iPad 标记 Mac 文件 each signal different intent from 随航, 连续性相机, or 接力 keywords.

Caption lines vs burned-in badges

Marketing screenshot overlays you control — "Markup from Mac on iPhone" headlines on gallery frames showing Mac Quick Look Markup sheets — are separate caption fields or burned-in PNG text. See Screenshot captions in Simplified Chinese for caption-field mechanics when overlays are editable in Connect.

Common mistakes on Continuity Markup zh-Hans listings

  • Leaving "Continuity Markup" untranslated — Apple and buyers expect 连续互通标记 or 标记 in zh-Hans regions; English-only overlay lines on otherwise Chinese copy looks unfinished
  • Conflating Continuity Markup with Sidecar — 随航 is iPad-as-second-display; Mac Quick Look → Markup sheet handoff is 连续互通标记 unless your English source genuinely leads with both
  • Conflating Continuity Markup with on-device iPhone Markup — Files Markup on iPhone alone is not Mac handoff unless your gallery shows Mac-initiated workflow
  • Conflating Continuity Markup with Continuity Camera — 连续性相机 is iPhone-as-webcam, not PDF Markup handoff
  • Conflating Continuity Markup with Handoff — 接力 is session resume, not Mac Preview Markup sending a document to iPad
  • Conflating Continuity Markup with AirDrop — 隔空投送 is share-sheet transfer, not the built-in Markup return-to-Mac sheet
  • Conflating Continuity Markup with Center Stage or Desk View — video-call framing is not document annotation handoff
  • Claiming Markup handoff in listing copy — product-page copy should describe user-facing annotation benefits, not imply AppLocale or your app performs Continuity Markup for buyers
  • Assuming cross-device annotation education localizes the store page — engineering and App Store metadata are independent workstreams

AppLocale FAQ

What is Apple Continuity Markup?

From Mac Preview, Finder, Mail, or Quick Look you click Markup; the document opens in a Markup sheet on a nearby iPhone or iPad on the same Apple ID. You annotate with finger, Apple Pencil, or Sketch; the annotated file returns to the Mac. Marketing that workflow on your en-US page does not auto-fill zh-Hans Connect fields.

Does mentioning Continuity Markup auto-translate my China listing?

No. Continuity Markup is a system macOS and iOS feature on the buyer's devices — it does not create or fill a Simplified Chinese localization row. Empty or English zh-Hans fields mean China buyers see en-US fallback on the product page.

What listing fields does AppLocale rewrite for Continuity Markup apps?

Paste-ready Simplified Chinese (zh-Hans) copy for App Store Connect listing fields you specify: title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text when included, and screenshot overlay or caption lines that mention Continuity Markup, Markup from Mac on iPhone or iPad, annotate PDF on iPhone, Sketch, or Insert from iPhone/iPad Markup — rewritten from your English originals with terms like 连续互通标记, 标记, 在 iPhone 上标记, and 用 iPad 标记 Mac 文件 where accurate.

How is this different from Sidecar Apple Pencil markup?

Sidecar makes iPad a Mac second display with Pencil markup on the extended canvas — 随航. Continuity Markup sends a document from Mac to iPhone or iPad in a Markup sheet and returns the annotated file — 连续互通标记. Different surfaces, different buyer vocabulary.

How is this different from on-device Markup in Files or Photos on iPhone?

On-device Markup annotates a file already open on iPhone or iPad — no Mac handoff. Continuity Markup is Mac-initiated: Preview, Finder, Mail, or Quick Look → Markup → iPhone/iPad sheet → return to Mac.

How is this different from Continuity Camera, Center Stage, or Handoff?

Continuity Camera is iPhone-as-Mac-webcam — 连续性相机. Center Stage is auto-framing on video calls — 人物居中. Handoff is session resume — 接力. Continuity Markup is document annotation handoff from Mac to iPhone or iPad — separate buyer vocabulary.

Does AppLocale implement Continuity Markup or configure Markup for buyers?

No. We deliver listing metadata copy only. Markup handoff integration and Continuity configuration are outside AppLocale scope. We rewrite how you describe existing Continuity Markup features on the store page — we do not implement them in the app or on buyer devices.

What character limits apply to zh-Hans Continuity Markup fields?

App name and subtitle are each up to 30 characters. Keywords allow up to 100 characters. Description and screenshot caption lines have longer limits but should stay concise — especially overlays that must fit on-device mockups.
